title: Question 11
passage:
Could you hold my place in line while I move my bike away from the entrance?
A. The bike rack is beside the café. B. I walked here from the station. C. Sure. I will tell the others you are coming right back.
passageZh:
我把自行車移離入口時，你可以幫我保留排隊的位置嗎？
A. 自行車架就在咖啡店旁邊。 B. 我是從車站走過來的。 C. 好啊，我會跟其他人說你馬上回來。
